Major Remodels in Colwich, KS

Colwich's older rural homes were built to last — and they have. The problem isn't structural; it's that 60-year-old homes were designed for 60-year-old lifestyles, and the accumulated effect of deferred maintenance and dated design eventually reaches the point where a room-by-room approach is less practical than a coordinated whole-home renovation.

A major remodel in Colwich takes the solid rural bones of a 1960s or 1970s home and rebuilds the interior to match how the family actually lives today — open kitchen concept, properly waterproofed bathrooms, updated electrical service, consistent modern flooring, and finishes that don't look like they're from the era when the home was built.

Wheatland Construction executes major remodels in Colwich and northwest Sedgwick County. We're a Veterans Approved Builder (ID: 00899), Home Advisor Certified since 2019, and family-owned since 2018.

What a Colwich Major Remodel Typically Includes

Kitchen renovation: Full gut and replacement — layout improvement, new cabinets, quartz countertops, appliances. Rural Colwich kitchens often benefit from opening closed layouts where structurally feasible.

Bathroom renovation: Full tile replacement, new vanities and fixtures, proper membrane waterproofing, exhaust ventilation that actually works and vents to exterior.

Electrical update: Older Colwich homes may have insufficient panel capacity and aluminum branch circuit wiring in some vintages. We address during a major remodel when walls are open.

Flooring throughout: Consistent new flooring — LVP for durability in rural households, tile in wet areas.

Interior finish refresh: Doors, trim, and paint throughout.

Colwich-Specific Considerations

Arkansas River clay soils and moisture: Colwich's alluvial soils create moisture conditions at exterior walls and basement areas that older homes may have absorbed over time. We assess during planning and address appropriately — not just cover over.

Rural plumbing infrastructure: Older Colwich homes may have galvanized supply lines. A major remodel is the most cost-effective time to update them.

Sedgwick County permits: Unincorporated Colwich properties permit through Sedgwick County Planning and Building. We handle all permitting.

How We Approach Major Remodeling in Colwich

Major remodels involve more coordination than single-room projects - structural assessments, permit packages with engineered drawings where required, phased scheduling to keep portions of the home livable, and subcontractor coordination for specialized trades. We manage all of it.

We price in writing with full scope documentation before work starts. Change orders are documented and approved before work proceeds.

Wheatland Construction has held Veterans Approved Builder status (ID: 00899) since we opened and has been Home Advisor Certified since 2019. We're licensed and insured in Kansas.

Frequently Asked Questions About Major Remodels in Colwich

How much does a major remodel cost in Colwich, KS?

Colwich major remodels range from $75,000 for a focused multi-room renovation to $240,000+ for a comprehensive whole-home project. Rural northwest Sedgwick County pricing. Written, line-item estimates.

Who handles permits for major remodeling in Colwich?

Sedgwick County Planning and Building for unincorporated properties. City of Colwich for homes inside city limits. We handle all permits.

How long does a major remodel take in Colwich?

4–9 months depending on scope. Projects involving structural changes and full electrical updates take toward the longer end.

Do you test for hazardous materials before demoing a Colwich home from the 1960s?

Yes — pre-1978 construction may contain asbestos in flooring, ceiling materials, and pipe insulation. We test before demo and handle remediation appropriately.

Is a major remodel better than selling and buying a newer home in Colwich?

Often yes for Colwich homeowners who own their land and value their location. The rural northwest Sedgwick County lifestyle is hard to replicate. A major remodel preserves the location while updating the home to current standards.

Does a major remodel add value in Colwich?

Yes. A fully renovated home in Colwich trades at a meaningful premium over unrenovated homes of the same vintage and location.
